scripts.speaker: Dwarf Grunburti
scripts.text:
A human?!
This land is full
of your kind. What
brings you here?

scripts.speaker: Dwarf Grunburti
scripts.text:
Living in Midgard and away from
my home town is painful enough, let alone facing a whiny human. Leave me alone!
Ask him about Dwarves.
Ask him what he is doing.
Request weapon creation.
Cancel.

scripts.speaker: Dwarf Grunburti
scripts.text:
What's to know about Dwarves?
We're the toughest race. After all, we can live anywhere, no matter
how harsh the environment may be.

scripts.speaker: Dwarf Grunburti
scripts.text:
I doubt your feeble mind can comprehend the how unendurable
it must be for you to live in my homeland, but you can try.
Try to imagine.

scripts.speaker: Dwarf Grunburti
scripts.text: Most of the knowledge and skills that you humans are so proud of were probably handed down from Dwarves.

scripts.speaker: Dwarf Grunburti
scripts.text:
This is especially true in the
case of smithing. Even the tools and weapons of the gods were made by my ancestors. You know that?

scripts.speaker: Dwarf Grunburti
scripts.text: We have the greatest knowlege and skills, but have accepted our fate to live in the cold, barren lands of the Giants.

scripts.speaker: Dwarf Grunburti
scripts.text:
Did you just ask what I am doing here? Mwahahaha! Waiting for any humans stupid enough to come
here so I can kick their ass!

scripts.speaker: Dwarf Grunburti
scripts.text:
Oh don't worry. I'd only humiliate myself by fighting with a weakling like you. Humans are so fragile, but they stubbornly cling to their arrogance and fight amongst
each other.

scripts.speaker: Dwarf Grunburti
scripts.text: As a race, your people are just hopeless. I wouldn't even share the same continent with a human! But alas, I have no choice.

scripts.speaker: Dwarf Grunburti
scripts.text:
The path to my hometown
disappeared after the war 1,000 years ago. Somehow, I can no longer find the way through the Yggdrasil Tree that will take me back...

scripts.speaker: Dwarf Grunburti
scripts.text:
I'm stuck here in Midgard.
At least I was fortunate enough to find this cave. We Dwarves are most cozy living underground, after all.

scripts.speaker: Dwarf Grunburti
scripts.text:
Hmm...
I'll need some things to make a weapon for you. What exactly were you interested in having?
Brisingamen
Megingjard
Sleipnir
Mjolnir

scripts.speaker: Dwarf Grunburti
scripts.text:
I will need...
^0000FF4 Freya's Jewel
4 Silver Ornament
3 Snow Crystal
3 Ripple
3 Drifting Air
2 Sapphire
3 Pearl
10 Opal
5 Cursed Ruby
20 Gold^000000
1 Necklace^000000...

scripts.speaker: Dwarf Grunburti
scripts.text: However, the time for me to create this Brisingamen has not yet come. You'll have to wait until the seals are released. Mwahahaha!

scripts.speaker: Dwarf Grunburti
scripts.text:
I will need...
^0000FF1 Gleipnir
20 Gold
10 Sapphire
10 Oridecon
1 Belt^000000

scripts.speaker: Dwarf Grunburti
scripts.text: However, the seals on Megingjard have not yet been released. Until then, you'll have to wait! Bwahahaha!

scripts.speaker: Dwarf Grunburti
scripts.text:
I will need...
^0000FF3 Wheel of the Unknown
5 Feather of Angel Wing
3 Sprit of Fish
4 Amblem of the Sun God
3 Breath of Spirit
20 Gold
10 Elunium
1 Slotted Boots^000000

scripts.speaker: Dwarf Grunburti
scripts.text: But even so, I can't create Sleipnir until the seals have been broken. Otherwise, you're out of luck, human. Hahaha~!

scripts.speaker: Dwarf Grunburti
scripts.text:
I will need...
^0000FF2 Thor's Gauntlets
4 Iron Maiden
5 Wrath of Valkyrie
5 Omen of Tempest
5 Billow
20 Oridecon
5 Elunium
40 Gold
1 Stunner^000000

scripts.speaker: Dwarf Grunburti
scripts.text: But I can't even create a replica of Mjolnir if the seals are still in place. Until they're released, you'll just have to wait. Bwahaha!

scripts.speaker: Dwarf Grunburti
scripts.text: We Dwarves have too much pride to demonstrate our skills in front of a lowly human!

scripts.speaker: Dwarf Grunburti
scripts.text: Stop bothering me and get out of here! Go play with some monsters, you simple minded fool!

scripts.speaker: Dwarf Grunburti
scripts.text:
I'll only present
my magnificent skills
to a human of incredibly
high standing!

scripts.speaker: Dwarf Grunburti
scripts.text:
Although I hate
most humans, I have
no choice but to respect the ones chosen by destiny. Go and bring your ^0000FFguildmaster^000000!

scripts.speaker: Dwarf Grunburti
scripts.text: Although it is very humiliating to present my valuable skills to a human being...

scripts.speaker: Dwarf Grunburti
scripts.text: All the seals have been released, and he who holds the Emperium is chosen by destiny. I have no choice but to respect you.

scripts.speaker: Dwarf Grunburti
scripts.text: First of all, I shall confirm whether or not you have brought all the necessary materials to forge a godly item! I hate it when humans come here without any purpose!

scripts.speaker: Dwarf Grunburti
scripts.text:
Hmm...
I guess you
want to have
^0000FFBrisingamen^000000!

scripts.speaker: Dwarf Grunburti
scripts.text:
Hmm...
I guess you
want to have
^0000FFMegingjard^000000!

scripts.speaker: Dwarf Grunburti
scripts.text:
Hmm...
I guess you
want to have
^0000FFSleipnir^000000!

scripts.speaker: Dwarf Grunburti
scripts.text:
Hmm...
I guess you
want to have
^0000FFMjolnir^000000!

scripts.speaker: Dwarf Grunburti
scripts.text: How dare you come here unprepared?! Did you forget what you needed to bring? Listen carefully this time!
Brisingamen
Megingjard
Sleipnir
Mjolnir

Hmpf.
I can't get any work done in here. Come with me to the ^0000FFunderground laboratory^000000 as my guest, human.

scripts.speaker: Dwarf Grunburti
scripts.text: Now hurry up! ^0000FFOnly one of each godly item^000000 will be given to the humans ^FF0000right after all the seals are released^000000!

scripts.speaker: Dwarf Grunburti
scripts.text:
Muhahahahahaha!
Out of my sight,
you dirty, filthy
human...!

scripts.speaker: Entrance Notice
scripts.text:
Only the most
worthy of humans
will possess the
power of the gods.

scripts.speaker: Dwarf Grunburti
scripts.text:
One of the godly
items has been created,
and the seals have been
restored. You'll have to
wait until they're all
released again...!

scripts.speaker: Dwarf Grunburti
scripts.text:
Bwahahahahahahaa!
Even though you're
just a human, I feel
pity for you~

scripts.speaker: Dwarf Grunburti
scripts.text:
How in the...
Get out of here!

scripts.speaker: Dwarf Grunburti
scripts.text:
How did one of you
stupid humans get in
here?! Only those who
hold the Emperium can
even think of entering
this place...!

scripts.speaker: Dwarf Grunburti
scripts.text:
It's incredibly
humiliating to do work for a human. But since destiny has chosen you as the bearer of an Emperium, I have no choice but to oblige your requests.

scripts.speaker: Dwarf Grunburti
scripts.text:
We only have
^FF000010 minutes^000000 to recreate one godly treasure. After that, the seals will restore themselves and I won't be able to create anything until they're released again...

scripts.speaker: Dwarf Grunburti
scripts.text:
^FF0000Don't be too slow^000000,
otherwise ^FF0000I will give
the chance to another
human^000000 right away!

scripts.speaker: Dwarf Grunburti
scripts.text:
Now...!
Choose the item
you wish for me
to create!
Brisingamen
Megingjard
Sleipnir
Mjolnir

scripts.speaker: Dwarf Grunburti
scripts.text:
B-Brisingamen?!
I've never expected
such insolence...!
This necklace will never have any meaning in my eyes unless it's worn by the goddess Freya.

scripts.speaker: Dwarf Grunburti
scripts.text:
But who am I to judge your worthiness? These treasures
select their owners with their own will. Let's see if Brisingamen will find you worthy!

scripts.speaker: Dwarf Grunburti
scripts.text:
Once again, I need following materials in order to reproduce
this godly treasure...

Cancel.

Never in my wildest
imaginings have I thought that I'd be crafting this masterpiece for a mere human. Give me a moment.

scripts.speaker: Dwarf Grunburti

The seals
have just been

scripts.speaker: Dwarf Grunburti

scripts.speaker: Dwarf Grunburti
scripts.text: Ah, just look at this dazzling beauty. No other piece of jewelry complemented Freya as well as Brisingamen.

scripts.speaker: Dwarf Grunburti
scripts.text:
Idiot human!
You didn't bring
everything I need to
recreate Brisingamen!
Hurry...!

scripts.speaker: Dwarf Grunburti
scripts.text:
Muhahahaha~
Somehow, I figured
you'd back out, human!

scripts.speaker: Dwarf Grunburti
scripts.text:
M- Megingjard?!
The girdle of might?!

scripts.speaker: Dwarf Grunburti
scripts.text: This belt was worn long ago by Thor, the mightest warrior ever. But since these treasures select their owners, we'll see whether or not it recognizes you as worthy!

20 Gold

1 Belt^000000...

I'd never believe that

Sleipnir...
Now, understand
that I can't create
the eight-legged stallion
of legend. However...

scripts.speaker: Dwarf Grunburti
scripts.text:
I can create a pair
of shoes that will possess the power of Sleipnir. It's a strange, but feasible process...
